source: MFL fresh live raw stats with liveScoring fallback

unitOnFieldDefinition.specialTeams: excluded; possession does not identify kicking formations
unitOnFieldDefinition.paused: false during halftime, between periods, awaiting overtime or awaiting final confirmation
unitOnFieldDefinition.unknown: null only when live unit state is unavailable
unitOnFieldDefinition.display: known on-field count; zero shown even when paused or possession is unavailable; reason flags retained

liveProbabilityModel.method: Game-state mean and matched variance; continuous fitted-rate NIG with shared NFL-game copula and player identity

inGameValidation.kind: Chronological and LOSO repaired historical replay

ytdCalibration.cohort: Submitted-starter player-games with known missing FS projection in an available archived FS week; separate rostered and feed-outage lines retained
ytdCalibration.input: Mean prior active-game scores strictly before the target week

pregameCalibration.method: Pooled source/position nonnegative linear calibration weighted by genuine submitted starter appearances; bench calibration retained
pregameCalibration.source: Separate matched FS and YTD starter OLS lines; YTD used when FS unavailable; retained bench-specific lines
pregameCalibration.fsStarterCohort: Genuine ADL/FAFL player-team-week starting appearances; imported duplicates removed
pregameCalibration.fsBenchCohort: League-specific bench, except PK and PN use pooled ADL/FAFL all-rostered player-games
pregameCalibration.weighting: One observation per real starter appearance, not one per unique NFL player-game

deployment.parameterSource: Frozen Chronological 2026 fit; all components trained on 2021-2025
deployment.scope: Current-week live point forecasts and joint H2H/Bonus simulations; future-week seasonlong engine unchanged

pregameCalibrationUpdate.noise: Existing continuous NIG conditional residual distribution retained; mean calibration update only

appearanceMatchedNoiseUpdate.method: Starter-appearance weighted residual variance and continuous fitted-rate NIG, matched to deployed source-position calibration; conditional mean and NFL dependence retained

model.model: F315 + 50% upcoming-week calibrated Sharks / retained NIG uncertainty

model.weekly_volatility: league-wide normalized weekly SD; residual-matched to the bye-adjusted mean
model.strength_uncertainty: week-specific persistent Normal team offset, residual-matched to the bye-adjusted mean

potential_points.validation: 2023 selection; rolling 2024-2025 holdout; residual downward bias remains
